sentences.en: This university has open admission, so you don't need to take any entrance exams.
sentences.zh: 这所大学实行免试入学，所以不需要参加任何入学考试。

sentences.en: Many community colleges have open admission policies for local residents.
sentences.zh: 很多社区学院对当地居民实施免试入学政策。

sentences.en: Our college offers an open admission program for transfer students in the fall semester.
sentences.zh: 我们学院在秋季学期为转学生提供免试入学项目。
